notes.title: Update for July 15 2025
notes.content: IT'S HERE! Long-awaited fixes to the Twitch integration - bye bye bot, hello chatting as the streamer! Note that this may require you to log out and back in to this site, and grab a fresh stream key. Also coming soon - more new story characters and the much-requested soundtrack! Stay tuned!

notes.title: Hotfix 5 June
notes.content:
Hello again! Few small fixes:

- Exit button on title now works as expected, as does the merch button. But who would want to stop playing anyway?
- Auto-86er issues with some of the new recipes have been resolved.
- Some minor graphical tweaks brought to us by our devoted testing team have been made!

Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: June 5th Update!
notes.content:
[b]Hello Cafe Keepers![/b]

We still have a lot of new goodies coming your way, but rather than keep you waiting much longer, we are dropping a big update patch today! Important changes to note:
- [b]COSMETICS ARE HERE[/b]! Decorate your cafe with items you can purchase in the shop for stars!
- The [b]rating system[/b] has been softened a little, separating accuracy and time, in the interest of fairness and accessability.
- [b]Caturday[/b]. 'Nuff said.
- [b]New random customers[/b] are available in the cafe - feel free to keep your suggestions coming!
- The recipe book now sports [b]alphabet tabs[/b], to allow for speedy navigation!
- [b]New recipes[/b] have been added, thanks to our fantastic Discord members!
- Some backend fixes have been pushed that will hopefully be invisible to you but make things a lot smoother on our end.

We hope that this brightens up your cafe and your day! And [u][b]thanks again[/b][/u] for all of your support and kind words!

notes.title: Patch Notes, Feb 2 2025
notes.content:
Hey hey! Back with another couple quick fixes and updates:

- You shouldn't appear "open" forever on the website anymore!
- Twitch connections should run a little more smoothly!
- There may be a couple new recipes using a new ingredient...

Thank you all for your support!

notes.title: Updates for 29 January 2025
notes.content:
Well hello again! It's time for some updates!

- We have cleaned up a lot of things on both sides of the Twitch integration, chat support should function with a marked improvement to stability. 
- Some small cosmetic changes have been put in place in preparation for further upcoming updates (did someone say "customization"?)
- A handful of new recipes have been added (and will continue to be in further updates!)
- Accessibility features - hovering over an ingredient and using the numbers 1-9 will automatically put that item in the spot in the grid, "Enter" will make the current item, and "Backspace" / "Del" will clear out the grid!

Thank you again for all of your support, and please keep your concerns and comments coming!

notes.title: Update 18 November
notes.content: Hi all! We've pushed a new update to the game client to disable the QR code display that you may have seen while we resolve some last minute server issues. Alongside this, you may notice your twitch sessions staying more stable! Happy Cafe-ing!

notes.title: V240830 Release
notes.content:
Hello! We are excited to announce the latest update to Let's Cafe! We have been working hard to improve the quality of life for you all as well as add functionality, capability, and content for everyone. We greatly appreciate everyone creating some of the most adorable cafes we've seen, and are excited to see what else you all can do! 

As for the update, we've had a long list of changes we've made based on feedback and recommendations for the player's quality of life! We have also squashed a few bugs, and worked hard on some fun secret items for your cafe! Here is the total list of changes:
[list]
[*] Credits Dialog now closes Properly
[*] Adjust Stars and NPC names so they do not overlap
[*] Escape now closes the end day dialog by "canceling" it
[*] Small visual alignment to the "Make this" button when you have the auto-make powerup
[*] Change wording on Extra Shelves in the shop from "Coming soon" to "Requires Shop Upgrade"
[*] Exit to Title from in game now has a confirmation dialog
[*] Added Customer Satisfaction Timer bar
[*] Edit the styles of Text Boxes and Sliders to be in line with our game's style.
[*] You can no longer hear NPCs talk when not in the Kitchen.
[*] Moved the Grid to align perfectly with the counter.
[*] Minutes Display on create new cafe now always display 2 digits to prevent text jumping
[*] The name of the previously made recipe will now display under the "Remake" button when you have that powerup.
[*] Old saves will now update to allow new Powerups that get added.
[*] Added Auto Generate Name button when creating a new Cafe
[*] Fixed issue with Mayor Chicken's final 2 stages crashing the game.
[*] Changed the notification Display to be more visible, dismissible, and immediate feedback.
[/list]

notes.title: Let's Cafe Demo now available!
notes.content:
We're very excited to announce the release of the Let's Cafe Demo! Not sure id this game is for you? Try out the Demo before investing in the full game! The demo is the same core loop of the game with all the cute cuddly characters you expect to see, with some slight changes:
[list]
[*]No NPC Story lines for you to play through.
[*]A limited amount of ingredients.
[*]A limited amount of recipes for you to create.
[/list]

Give it a shot; we hope to see you in our Cafe soon!

notes.title: V240813 Bug fixes and tweaks
notes.content:
Hello all! We greatly appreciate the support and feedback we've received! We are excited that we have received such a warm welcome from the community! If you have a bug, please let us know in the discord channel linked on the Steam page. We are also welcome to more recipe suggestions, so please let us know there as well! Now, onto the fixes!

[h1]Bug fixes and Tweaks[/h1]
[list]
[*]Tweaked the End of Day Screen to signal (Press Any Button to continue)
[*]Lower sloth spawn chance
[*]Satisfying a customer's order before they give it, no longer creates an awkward staring contest. The customer's order won't be satisfied until the order is submitted now.
[*]Cafe name input box will now autofocus on creation of the create dialog.
[*]Reorganize backend side of recipe handling.
[*]Recipe book will now turn the page with a and d agnostic of caps or not.
[*]Fixed Oat milk being able to appear twice in the shop.
[/list]
